dataset_metadata.disclaimer: New AI-generated English drafts of the recorded Classical Chinese; not scholarly reviewed. Original source interpretations are not verified geometry or modern etymology.

shuowen:3401.text: A fruit name. Formed from 木, with 𥝢 indicating the sound; 𥝢 is ancient-script 利.

shuowen:3402.text: A jujube resembling a persimmon. Formed from 木, with 甹 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3403.text: A red-fruited plant. Formed from 木, with 市 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3404.text: The 梅 tree. Formed from 木, with 冄 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3405.text: The 枏 tree; its fruit is edible. Formed from 木, with 每 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3406.text: A fruit. Formed from 木, with abbreviated 可 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3407.text: A fruit. Formed from 木, with 示 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3408.text: A fruit. Formed from 木, with 子 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3409.text: A fruit. Formed from 木, with 兆 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3410.text: Winter peach. Formed from 木, with 敄 indicating the sound. Read like 髦.

shuowen:3411.text: A fruit whose seeds resemble small chestnuts. Formed from 木, with 辛 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: “A woman’s presentation gifts do not exceed 𣓀 and chestnuts.”

shuowen:3412.text: A tree, apparently planted over Confucius’s tomb. Formed from 木, with 皆 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3413.text: The 桂 tree. Formed from 木, with abbreviated 㑴 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3414.text: A tree south of the Yangtze, foremost among medicinal substances. Formed from 木, with 圭 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3415.text: The male is called 棠; the female, 杜. Formed from 木, with 尚 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3416.text: The 甘棠 tree. Formed from 木, with 土 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3417.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 習 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3418.text: A tree used to make combs. Formed from 木, with 單 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3419.text: A tree whose wood can be bent into basins. Formed from 木, with 韋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3420.text: A pliable tree; government craftsmen use it for flexible wheel rims. Formed from 木, with 酋 indicating the sound. Read like 糗.

shuowen:3421.text: A tree described as 级椐; the plant name is uncertain. Formed from 木, with 邛 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3422.text: The 毋杶 tree. Formed from 木, with 侖 indicating the sound. Read like 屯, the Changes hexagram.

shuowen:3423.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 胥 indicating the sound. Read like 芟 in 芟刈, “to mow.”

shuowen:3424.text: The 梅 tree. Formed from 木, with 央 indicating the sound. Another explanation: the 橦 timber tree south of the Yangtze; its fruit is called 柍.

shuowen:3425.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 癸 indicating the sound. Also: to measure.

shuowen:3426.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 咎 indicating the sound. Read like 皓.

shuowen:3427.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 周 indicating the sound. Read like 丩.

shuowen:3428.text: 樸樕, a tree. Formed from 木, with 欶 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3429.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 彞 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3430.text: A green-barked tree. Formed from 木, with 岑 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3431.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 叕 indicating the sound. Yizhou has a county called 棳.

shuowen:3432.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with abbreviated 號 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3433.text: The 遬其 tree. Formed from 木, with 炎 indicating the sound. Read like 導 in 三年導服, referring to three years of mourning dress; the phrase is uncertain.

shuowen:3434.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 遄 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3435.text: The 卽來 tree. Formed from 木, with 京 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3436.text: The 杶 tree. Formed from 木, with 意 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3437.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 費 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3438.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 虖 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3439.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 禹 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3440.text: A woody plant. Formed from 木, with 藟 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3441.text: The 赤栜 tree. Formed from 木, with 夷 indicating the sound. The Odes says: “In the lowland grow 杞 and 桋.”

shuowen:3442.text: The 栟櫚 palm. Formed from 木, with 并 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3443.text: The 栟櫚 palm; it can be used to make screens. Formed from 木, with 㚇 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3444.text: The 楸 tree. Formed from 木, with 賈 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: “Plant six 檟 trees in the Pu garden.”

shuowen:3445.text: The 梓 tree. Formed from 木, with 奇 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3446.text: The 楸 tree. Formed from 木, with abbreviated 宰 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3447.text: The 梓 tree. Formed from 木, with 秋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3448.text: A kind of 梓 tree. Large ones make inner and outer coffins; small ones provide bow timber. Formed from 木, with 𠶷 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3449.text: The 檆 tree. Formed from 木, with 皮 indicating the sound. Another explanation: to break.

shuowen:3450.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 煔 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3451.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 秦 indicating the sound. Another explanation: 菆, brushwood.

shuowen:3452.text: The mountain 㯉 tree. Formed from 木, with 尻 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3453.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 屯 indicating the sound. The Book of Xia says: “杶, 榦, 栝 and 柏.”

shuowen:3454.text: The 杶 tree. Formed from 木, with 筍 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3455.text: 白桵, the 棫 tree. Formed from 木, with 妥 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3456.text: The 白桵 tree. Formed from 木, with 或 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3457.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 息 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3458.text: The 樻 tree. Formed from 木, with 居 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3459.text: The 椐 tree. Formed from 木, with 貴 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3460.text: The 柔 tree. Formed from 木, with 羽 indicating the sound. Its acorn is also called 様.

shuowen:3461.text: The 栩 tree. Formed from 木, with 予 indicating the sound. Read like 杼.

shuowen:3462.text: The fruit of 栩. Formed from 木, with 羕 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3463.text: 劉, the 劉杙 tree. Formed from 木, with 弋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3464.text: 枇杷, a tree. Formed from 木, with 比 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3465.text: 桔梗, a medicinal plant. Formed from 木, with 吉 indicating the sound. Another explanation: straight timber.

shuowen:3466.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 乍 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3467.text: A tree from Mount Tuo. Formed from 木, with 乎 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3468.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 晉 indicating the sound. A text says: “Bamboo arrows resemble 榗.”

shuowen:3469.text: The 羅 tree. Formed from 木, with 㒸 indicating the sound. The Odes says: “In the lowland grow 𣔾 trees.”

shuowen:3470.text: A tree used for beds and small tables. Formed from 木, with 叚 indicating the sound. Read like 賈.

shuowen:3471.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 惠 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3472.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 苦 indicating the sound. The Odes says: “Hazel and 楛 grow thickly.”

shuowen:3473.text: A tree used for the axles of large carts. Formed from 木, with 齊 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3474.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 乃 indicating the sound. Read like 仍.

shuowen:3475.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 𩔤 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3476.text: Sour jujube. Formed from 木, with 貳 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3477.text: A jujube. Formed from 木, with 僕 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3478.text: A small sour jujube. Formed from 木, with 然 indicating the sound. Another explanation: to dye.

shuowen:3479.text: A tree with pear-like fruit. Formed from 木, with 尼 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3480.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 肖 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3481.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 𨾀 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3482.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 寽 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3483.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 夋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3484.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 畢 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3485.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 剌 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3486.text: A tree from Shu, usable for making sauce. Formed from 木, with 句 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3487.text: A tree from Mount Fajiu. Formed from 木, with 庶 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3488.text: A tree whose wood can make carts. Formed from 木, with 方 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3489.text: The 枋 tree. Formed from 木, with 畺 indicating the sound. Another explanation: a name for a hoe handle.

shuowen:3490.text: A tree whose bark is used to wrap pine resin. Formed from 木, with 雩 indicating the sound. Read like 華.

shuowen:3491.text: A yellow-wooded tree. Formed from 木, with 辟 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3492.text: An aromatic tree. Formed from 木, with 㞣 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3493.text: Resembles 茱萸 and grows in Huainan. Formed from 木, with 殺 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3494.text: A tree used for the curved wheel rims of large carts. Formed from 木, with 戚 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3495.text: A tree. Formed from 木, with 昜 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3496.text: River willow. Formed from 木, with 聖 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3497.text: A small 楊 tree. Formed from 木, with 戼 indicating the sound; 戼 is ancient-script 酉.

shuowen:3498.text: A large tree used for hoe handles. Formed from 木, with 𠣬 indicating the sound.

shuowen:3499.text: A tree resembling 欄. Formed from 木, with 䜌 indicating the sound. The Rites specifies: the Son of Heaven plants pine; feudal lords, cypress; grand officers, 欒; and officers, 楊.

shuowen:3500.text: The 棠棣 tree. Formed from 木, with 多 indicating the sound.
